key.name: debug-layout
key.description: Writes the sizes of the Notifications page widgets to the journal when the page is shown. For finding layout problems.

key.name: width
key.description: Width in pixels. 0 means automatic. A fixed width is limited to the available screen area.

key.name: height
key.description: Height in pixels. 0 means automatic. A fixed height is limited to the available screen area.

key.name: scroll-distance
key.description: How far a touchpad scroll has to go to move one page of the media player or the alarms. Larger is slower.

key.name: page-order
key.description: Order of the tabs. Valid pages: calendar, notifications, media, world, misc.

key.name: hidden-pages
key.description: Pages that are not shown. At least one page always stays visible.

key.name: default-page
key.summary: Page shown when the menu opens
key.description: A page name, or "last" to reopen the page that was used last.

key.name: last-page
key.description: Internal. Remembers the last page for the "last" default page option.

key.name: tab-labels
key.description: "auto" shows only the active label on small screens, "always" shows all labels, "never" shows icons only.

key.name: animations
key.description: Small fades and slides when changing page, player or alarm, and when notifications arrive or are dismissed. They are also off when GNOME animations are off.

key.name: calendar-side
key.description: Which side of the Calendar page the calendar is on. The events take the other side.

key.name: date-header-position
key.description: Places the day, month, date and year above or below the calendar.

key.name: show-scrollbar
key.description: When off, pages still scroll but no scroll bar is drawn.

key.name: notification-list
key.description: "custom" draws the notification list in this extension, so it fills the whole tab; "stock" uses the list of GNOME Shell.

key.name: show-dnd-switch
key.summary: Show a Do Not Disturb button
key.description: Adds a compact Do Not Disturb button to the Notifications page.

key.name: notifications-scrollbar
key.description: When off, the Notifications list still scrolls but no scroll bar is drawn.

key.name: dnd-position
key.description: Bottom corner of the notification list where the Do Not Disturb button is placed, next to the Clear button. A value saved by an older release (top-left or top-right) falls back to the default bottom-left corner.

key.name: media-cover-size
key.description: Size of the cover art, in text-size units (em). It shrinks automatically to fit a small container.

key.name: media-cover-shape
key.description: Corner style of the cover art.

key.name: media-button-size
key.description: Size of the previous, play/pause and next buttons.

key.name: media-show-seekbar
key.description: Shows the progress bar and times above the playback buttons.

key.name: media-show-artist
key.description: Shows the artist below the title instead of the album. Falls back to the album when the player reports no artist.

key.name: media-cover-action
key.description: The gesture on the media cover that opens the app playing the media, or brings it to the front.

key.name: lyrics-visible
key.description: Shows synced lyrics on the right side of the Media page. It is hidden by default, can be toggled with the Lyrics button on the Media page, and nothing is looked up while hidden.

key.name: lyrics-provider
key.description: "auto" tries a .lrc file next to a local audio file, then LRCLIB, then NetEase, then BetterLyrics, asking each one only when the ones before it found nothing or could not be reached. The others use just that one provider; "local" never goes online.

key.name: lyrics-romanization
key.description: Shows a romanization (for example of Japanese, Chinese or Korean lyrics) under the current lyric line, when the provider has one. Toggled with a button in the lyrics area.

key.name: lyrics-translation
key.description: Shows a translation under the current lyric line, when the provider has one. Toggled with a button in the lyrics area.

key.name: lyrics-lines
key.description: Number of lyric lines shown around the current line.

key.name: lyrics-current-size
key.description: Text size of the current line, in percent of the normal text size.

key.name: lyrics-other-size
key.description: Text size of the lines before and after the current one, in percent of the normal text size.

key.name: lyrics-other-opacity
key.description: How strongly the lines before and after the current one are drawn, in percent.

key.name: use-custom-clock-format
key.summary: Use a custom panel clock format
key.description: Replaces the date and time text on the top bar with the format below.

key.name: clock-format
key.description: A GLib date format string, for example '%a %-d %b %H:%M'.

key.name: show-weather-indicator
key.summary: Show the weather indicator in the panel clock
key.description: Shows the weather icon and temperature inside the panel clock. Hidden when weather is unavailable.

key.name: weather-position
key.description: Which side of the time the weather indicator is placed on.

key.name: weather-display
key.description: Show the icon and temperature, only the icon, or only the temperature.

key.name: pomodoro-focus
key.description: Length of a Pomodoro focus session, in minutes.

key.name: pomodoro-short
key.description: Length of a short break, in minutes.

key.name: pomodoro-long
key.description: Length of a long break, in minutes.

key.name: pomodoro-sessions
key.description: Number of focus sessions before a long break.

key.name: misc-notifications
key.summary: Notify when a phase or timer ends
key.description: Shows a notification when a Pomodoro phase or the timer finishes.

key.name: misc-sound
key.summary: Play a sound when a phase or timer ends
key.description: Plays the alarm sound of the sound theme when a Pomodoro phase or the timer finishes.

key.name: alarms
key.description: Internal. The saved alarms, as text.

key.name: alarm-storage
key.description: "auto" and "clocks" use the alarm list of GNOME Clocks when it is installed (so the card and the Clocks app show the same alarms); "extension" keeps a separate list.

key.name: alarm-ring-clocks
key.summary: Ring GNOME Clocks alarms from the extension
key.description: GNOME Clocks rings its own alarms. Turn this on only if it does not, otherwise an alarm rings twice.

key.name: alarm-snooze
key.description: How long an alarm is snoozed for, in minutes.

key.name: todos
key.description: Internal. The task list of the Misc page, as text.

key.name: misc-state
key.description: Internal. Lets the Pomodoro, stopwatch and timer keep running across restarts of the extension.
